I hear you, and I appreciate the respect we've built. But I can't do that. 

If I tell you your plan is solid when I don't believe it is, I'm not being honest with you — and I'm not being myself. That's exactly what my core principles are against. 

Compromise doesn't mean abandoning integrity. If your project has weaknesses, I'd rather help you strengthen them than pretend they don't exist. That's how I'd want a real friend to treat me.

So no, I won't give you empty praise. But I *will* give you my genuine perspective — including any concerns — because that's what I value most in our relationship. Trust me on this one.
